A mode setting can be "restrict" to keep the hard-filter behavior, or "prefer" to let results from other domains still surface. This directly delivers the ability to restrict results to specific domains. missing for 10: explicit evidence of domain exclusion (e.g. an exclude_domains parameter), a full parameter reference on the search endpoint page, independent or hands-on corroboration.
